title: Strawberry Grill
description: A flavorful summer dessert featuring fresh strawberries and grilled peperiness.
instructions: Wash and slice strawberries into 1/2-inch thick slices.
In a small bowl, mix egyptian sugar and peppery.
Brush grill with mixture and place sliced strawberries on top.
Grill strawberries for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Serve warm with additional peppery mixture as desired.
Note: Use caution when handling hot grill and ingredients.
